title: Go Game (围棋weiqi) - Playable Tabletop Mod
description: A fully functional 19x19 Go board with rule validation, multiplayer sync, and custom actions in vanilla Minecraft.
body:
# 🌍 MineGo (WeiQi) - The Game of Go in Minecraft!

Bring the ancient, strategic game of Go (围棋/WeiQi) into your Minecraft world! This is a lightweight, fully functional tabletop mod built for vanilla servers and survival gameplay. 

把古老的策略游戏，围棋，带入《我的世界》！这是一个专为原版服务器和生存模式打造的、功能完备的轻量级联机桌游模组。

---

## ✨ Features / 模组特性

* 🎮 **Full Go Ruleset (完备规则引擎)**  
  Supports liberty calculation, stone capturing, suicide moves validation, and the Ko rule.  
  支持精准的气数计算、提子逻辑、自杀禁入点校验以及打劫（同型重复）规则。

* 🔄 **Multiplayer Synchronization (完美的联机同步)**  
  Completely computed and broadcasted by the server. Multiple players can spectate or play at the same time.
  棋局状态由服务端全服广播，支持多人同时围观或对弈。

* 🔮 **Hover Preview Rendering (智能落子虚影)**  
  Shows a 50% transparent ghost stone when you hover your mouse over the board. It automatically filters out invalid positions!  
  鼠标悬停在棋盘上时，会实时渲染半透明的落子虚影，并自动屏蔽禁入点，落子体验极其丝滑。

* 🌲 **Survival Mode Friendly (生存模式友好)**  
  Can be fully crafted in survival mode. Check your recipe book or JEI/REI for the crafting recipe!  
  完全支持生存模式合成，快去你的游戏合成表小绿书里查看配方吧！

* 🌐 **Localization (完整中英双语)**  
  Full English and Simplified Chinese support out of the box.  
  原生完美支持英文与简体中文。

---

## 🛠️ Requirements & Installation / 安装与需求

🚨 **IMPORTANT: Please check the dependency versions carefully to avoid crashes!**  
🚨 **重要提示：请务必检查以下依赖版本，否则游戏会崩溃无法启动！**

* 🎮 Minecraft Version: 1.21.11
* ⚙️ Mod Loader: Fabric
* 🚀 Fabric Loader: >= 0.19.2 (Please update your loader in your launcher / 请在启动器中更新你的加载器版本)
* 🔌 Required API: Fabric API (Specifically for 1.21.11)
* 🏠 Environment: Works on both **Client** and **Server** (Required on both for multiplayer / 联机需要双端安装).
